title: ci: Lint's three Type Check jobs, the Test Core shards, dogfood and Temporal each rebuild the workspace (3.5–5.8 min per job, ~25–30 job-min per CI+Lint pair) — extend #21186's turbo remote cache to them
body:
Filing gate: ③ a maintainer-directed task — the maintainer, after this seat's CI assessment in this session, verbatim: 「CI 优化按照你的建议创建任务」 — carrying ① a measured cost with a named fix site: each CI and Lint run rebuilds the workspace in several jobs that share nothing (the three `Type Check` jobs, the `Test Core` shards' closures, the dogfood shards, Temporal, Build Core), 3.5–5.8 minutes per job, about 25–30 job-minutes per CI+Lint pair, while the turbo remote cache #21186 wired is read by `ci.yml`'s Build Core only. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287, `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`). ⛔ Not a claim. The `tooling` entry rule (`triage-duties.md:34`) is met by the maintainer's instruction quoted here; the guarded surfaces are the required contexts `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Temporal Conformance`.
Reader: triage first-touch → `domain:devx` (CI wiring; #21186 was routed `domain:spec` — triage decides); the owning seat dispatches it.
Dedupe: page-looped REST listings, closed included (union 1,266 as on the sibling cards) grepped for `build once|share.*dist|remote cache|turbo.*(cache|remote)|duplicate.*build|rebuild` → 5 hits: #21186 (closed 2026-10-05: wire the Vercel turbo remote cache — team object-stack — into `ci.yml`; trusted events write, PRs read, signed), #21193 (closed: build hashes omit five root inputs the builds read), #11264 and #19086 (closed: two cache-served-dist pitfalls, kept below as pins), #19541 (unrelated). None extends the cache beyond Build Core.

## What is measured

- `lint.yml` passes no `TURBO_TOKEN` / `TURBO_TEAM` / `TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY` (grep: 0 lines), so its three builds cannot hit the remote cache; `ci.yml` passes them only in the Build Core job (the block at about `:2185-2219`, "Turbo remote cache (#21186)").
- Jobs API, step timestamps, `pull_request` runs 37567293616 (CI) and 37567293525 (Lint), same commit:
  - `Type Check · workspace`: build 3.5 min, then typecheck 6.2; `Type Check · consumer gates`: build 3.5; `Type Check · debt ledger`: build 4.5.
  - Build Core: build packages 6.2 min.
  - Dogfood shards 2/3, 1/3, 3/3: build dogfood deps 5.4 / 5.2 / 3.8 min; Temporal: build driver-sql deps 1.7 and more.
  - Nothing is passed between jobs as an artifact; every heavy job repeats checkout + setup-pnpm + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (install itself is cheap, 0.07–0.18 min).
- Per CI+Lint pair that is roughly 25–30 job-minutes of repeated build; the queue re-runs the same set per entry (about 235 job-minutes per queue build).
- Setup-side caches today: pnpm store via actions/cache keyed on the lockfile; turbo LOCAL cache via actions/cache keyed per job + shard + ref + sha (a new entry per run; restore-keys fall back to main); the remote cache only in Build Core.

## Done when

- The three Lint `Type Check` jobs and the `ci.yml` build steps of the Test Core shards, the dogfood shards and Temporal read the turbo remote cache with the same env block, the same signing rule and the same trusted-event write rule as #21186 (writes only on `merge_group` and `push` to `main`; PRs read).
- Measured before/after on one `pull_request` run and one `merge_group` run: each affected build step's seconds and turbo's cache-hit summary lines, quoted in the PR body with run ids; the expected effect is each 3.5–5.8-minute build step falling to cache-restore time on a warm cache.
- The two known pitfalls are checked and pinned: #19086 (a step that writes artifacts from a cache-served dist must not be among those served) and #21193 (the build hash covers every root input the builds read, so a cache hit is a correct hit).
- If the remote cache cannot serve a job (signature or permission shape), the alternative measured is an upload-artifact of `dist/` from Build Core consumed by the typecheck jobs; the PR states which route landed and why.
- ⛔ No job removed, no required context changed, no new gate; ⛔ the local actions/cache entries stay until the remote hit rate is measured.
